summary: Tested the 3 marketing bug fixes (PDF date range + Attn alignment, revert-acceptance endpoint, and Session Costing quotation snapshot). 11/11 pytest cases pass. Frontend wiring verified — revert button renders on Accepted quotations with correct data-testid.

issues: ESLint dev overlay ('react-hooks/exhaustive-deps rule not found') covers login form in dev preview. Non-blocking (dismissable); still visible to marketing users during development.

critical_code_review_comments: revert-acceptance uses $unset on training_date/end_date/training_dates but session was already deleted before quotation reset — order is safe. However client_response_notes and venue are NOT unset on revert; they remain from prior accept. Minor: consider clearing them so a subsequent decline/accept isn't polluted.

finance_session.get_session_costing.quotation_snapshot exposes group_price and rate_per_pax but the frontend SessionCosting only reads total_amount / pricing_type / rate_per_pax — group_price field is unused (dead payload). Not a bug.

In test_invoice_endpoint_blocked_when_issued (regression), the guard only fires when session.invoice_id is set OR explicit invoice_id is passed. If neither is set and there's an issued invoice in the collection, the legacy candidate lookup misses it (statuses filter excludes 'issued') and a NEW invoice is created. This is a pre-existing Phase 3A behavior, out of scope for this ticket, but worth flagging.

success_rate.frontend: smoke-verified (revert button renders with correct data-testid on Accepted rows)

seed_data_creation: All seeded records tagged with iter52_test:true and cleaned up per class via autouse fixture. Seeded: marketing_clients, quotations, sessions, invoices as needed per test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite for iter 52 lives at /app/backend/tests/test_marketing_bugfixes_iter52.py. It covers client-response end_date persistence, quotation PDF for single/range/list dates, revert-acceptance happy path + 409 financial-history guard + 400 state guard, session-costing quotation snapshot (linked + null), and Phase3A INVOICE_LOCKED regression. All 11 pass against current backend.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature testing pass. All 3 reported bugs are fixed correctly at the API level: (1) end_date is persisted on client-response and PDF endpoint returns 200 application/pdf for single date / range / list; (2) /revert-acceptance returns 200 and deletes the draft session for the happy path, returns 409 SESSION_HAS_FINANCIAL_HISTORY when an issued invoice exists, and returns 400 when quotation is not 'accepted'; (3) /api/finance/session/{id}/costing now returns a quotation snapshot (total_amount=8000, pricing_type='lumpsum') for auto-created sessions and null for manual sessions.
